Package com.nexuslink.ui.diagnostics

Class DiagnosticsDialog

java.lang.Object
com.nexuslink.ui.diagnostics.DiagnosticsDialog
public final class DiagnosticsDialog extends Object
A reusable connection-diagnostics dialog: runs a list of ConnectionDiagnostics.Steps on a background thread and fills a live Step/Status/Detail/Time table as each step completes (via the runner's per-step callback). The pure sequencing/stop-on-failure logic lives in ConnectionDiagnostics; this class is only the UI over it, so any protocol view can offer a "Diagnose" action by handing it NetworkProbes.basicSteps(...) (plus any protocol steps).
